descriptionPlain:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare. 

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.  

 At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.


**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.


Position Summary
We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Architect, reporting to the Sr Manager- AI & Platform Architecture, to design, deliver, and continuously improve our Product-to-Cash landscape on Salesforce. This is a coaching and mentoring–focused role: you will guide engineers and solution designers, raise architectural standards, and bring deep hands-on expertise in Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), the billing system, and the broader quote-to-cash lifecycle.
Working in close partnership with other Architects, you will help solve complex business and technical challenges and ensure solutions are designed to best serve the evolving needs of the company. The ideal candidate pairs strong Salesforce architecture experience with an AI-first mindset, applying Agentforce and Claude-based solutions to solve problems, and the ability to identify and resolve process and technology gaps across the Product-to-Cash value chain, ensuring solutions align to their core business domains and to the enterprise taxonomy framework that underpins domain roadmaps and technology transformation.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the architectural coach and mentor for engineers and solution designers across the Product-to-Cash domain, building team capability in Revenue Cloud Advanced and billing
Partner closely with the Principal Salesforce Architect to align on architectural direction, solve complex business and technical challenges together, and ensure solutions are designed to best serve the evolving needs of the company
Produce High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), and conceptual diagrams that clearly communicate architecture to technical and business audiences
Manage architecture and system roadmaps, ensuring alignment with platform standards and the long-term direction of the Product-to-Cash landscape
Define, maintain, and enforce platform standards across the Salesforce ecosystem
Build Proof of Concepts (POCs) to prove out the architecture and validate design decisions before delivery
Actively participate in requirement gathering, clarifying scope and resolving ambiguity early in the lifecycle
Work with the integration team to design and govern integrations, ensuring seamless communication and data flow across systems
Provide hands-on Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA)/CPQ coaching, including configuration patterns, design trade-offs, and implementation best practices
Own the end-to-end architecture of the Product-to-Cash lifecycle: quoting, contracting, ordering, fulfilment, billing, invoicing, revenue, customer success, and customer support
Architect and govern the billing system and billing platform, ensuring accurate invoicing, billing schedules, payment handling, dunning, and revenue recognition flows
Identify and resolve process gaps and technology gaps across Product-to-Cash, defining remediation approaches and driving them to resolution
Apply an AI-first mindset to problem solving, leveraging Agentforce and Claude-based solutions where they add value
Work with the development team to hand over designs cleanly, ensuring they have the context and clarity needed to build
During project execution, work with SMEs and Product Owners to address any requirement gaps and shape the right solution
Extend and mature the Product-to-Cash solution as business needs evolve, ensuring the architecture scales with new products, pricing models, and billing scenarios
Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform and Revenue Cloud
Apply architectural and engineering concepts to meet operational requirements such as scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, extensibility, availability, and manageability
Conduct research and develop Proof of Concepts on emerging Salesforce and billing capabilities, recommending solutions that are functionally robust and cost-effective
Promote the adoption of design patterns and standard processes for solution design and development
Partner with data and integration architects to ensure data integrity, security, compliance, and seamless data flow between billing, ERP, and other systems
Work closely with solution architects to ensure individual solutions align with the overall enterprise architecture
Contribute to a learning community within the enterprise architecture discipline, fostering continuous improvement
Required Experience & Skills
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
10+ years of Salesforce experience across implementation, configuration, and solution design
3–5 years of Salesforce architecture experience (minimum required)
Deep, hands-on expertise in Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA)/ CPQ, with the ability to coach and mentor others on the platform
Proven experience producing HLD, LLD, and conceptual diagrams, and managing architecture and system roadmaps
Proven experience architecting and delivering end-to-end Product-to-Cash solutions: quoting, contracting, ordering, fulfilment, billing, revenue, customer success, and customer support
Strong experience with billing systems and billing platforms, including invoicing, billing schedules, payments, dunning, and revenue recognition
Experience working with integration teams to design and govern cross-system integrations
Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve process gaps and technology gaps across the Product-to-Cash value chain
An AI-first mindset, with exposure to Agent force and Claude-based solutions for solving business and technical problems
Experience working with Salesforce Connected Apps (applications from the Salesforce AppExchange)
Proven experience designing and delivering complex B2B SaaS Salesforce solutions
Familiarity with managed packages such as Gong, DocuSign CLM, Kantata, Gainsight, Showpad, Qualtrics, or similar enterprise apps is a plus
Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture capabilities and ecosystem, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud
Strong leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect preferred
Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, C4, ArchiMate, etc.)
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Understanding of security architecture principles and practices
#LI-AJ1
#LI-Remote
